encoding: 8-bit RGB, rows north to south. R: metres to the nearest bank or rock (0 = land, capped at 255); G, B: downstream direction x and z, mapped from -1…1 to 0…255 (land 128).
source: Water triangles of models/anos-v3 (OpenStreetMap water outline) and DRAGON_TEETH in public/valley-bridge.mjs; exact Euclidean distance transform.
